decisions.description: This decision element checks to see if the Account selected is a Person Account. If the record is a Person Account, the end-user should not be given the choice to create an AccountAccountRelation. Conversely, if the originating record is an Organization Account, the end-user should not be given the choice to create ContactContactRelations.
